description: This file defines the DashboardController class for the Goteo project, managing user dashboard actions such as activity overview, rewards, subscriptions, messages, mailing, and wallet functionalities.

classes.name: DashboardController
classes.description: Controller handling user dashboard actions including activity, rewards, subscriptions, messages, mailing, and wallet views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets theme, and checks user authentication.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Builds the sidebar menu based on the section and zone, adding relevant links and data.

methods.name: activityAction
methods.description: Displays user activity including investments, interests, and favorite projects.

methods.name: mySubscriptionsAction
methods.description: Shows active Stripe subscriptions for the user.

methods.name: mailingAction
methods.description: Shows sent mails for the user.

methods.name: walletAction
methods.description: Displays user's wallet and project suggestions based on interests.
